title: One bit of possibility
prompt: Use the supplied image as the starting frame. Preserve its exact monochrome palette, physical hardware, framing and material texture. Minimal black-and-white 16mm film, natural grain and subtle optical softness. Motion must be physically plausible, very small and deliberate. No color, humanoids, new objects, morphing, holograms, glow, music, narration or generated text. Locked macro camera. Hold still, then the one pale flip-dot disc pivots once on its axle and settles. Surrounding black discs remain still. Sound: one dry mechanical tick, quiet room tone. End on a still frame.
